content: eBay Browse API price/shippingCost are reported as separate fields (item price vs shipping cost), not pre-summed; sold-listing data (Marketplace Insights) similarly exposes item sold price and shipping cost separately, plus lastSoldDate (a field not present in Browse API). Naive scripts that only read 'price' will misrepresent true landed cost when free-shipping-inflated-price vs separate-shipping-fee listings are compared.
